dataset.abstract:
Thailand is one of the tropical countries teeming with diverse flora and vegetation. The diverse vascular plants of Thailand with estimated number of no less than 10,000 species, have been recorded and published in continuation in the Flora of Thailand since 1970 under the Flora of Thailand Project. The Flora of Thailand Project, whose aim is to produce a complete floristic treatment of the entire vascular flora. A large number of families and up to volume 14 (2020) now have been published (see the Flora of Thailand publications page.). The treatments cover brief introduction; families, genus and species descriptions; identification keys, synonymy, distribution, distribution in Thailand, ecology, vernacular names, uses, taxonomical notes, illustrations and colour plates..
An e-flora of Thailand is an online Flora of Thailand publications which provides the descriptions of families, genera, species and lower taxa, illustrations and coloured plates from published volumes. New information, additional images, corrected authorities, currently accepted names mainly based on Plants of the World online and Angiosperm Phylogeny Website are also provided.
